question: Which upstream sites preserve target incidence after generic same-answer donor transport is measured out of sample?
population: All 32 transform-C same-answer rows from each frozen builder. Within each task, even row indices are discovery and odd row indices are sealed validation; token alignment and identical base/donor answer IDs are hard gates.
sites: The same complete 179-site population as the target atlas: all 162 heads in layers 0--17 and MLP0--16.
intervention: For every site and split, patch its full native response from C donor into C base, then measure final answer-margin movement and both frozen physical reader-mode movements. Base, donor, and self patches are included per split.
selection: Use only discovery controls plus the already frozen target-atlas metrics. Normalize absolute C margin movement by the corresponding target full-effect RMS. Rank sites lexicographically by target causal magnitude divided by 0.05 plus worst discovery-control fraction, then target magnitude; freeze the first 20. Validation controls may not alter the ranking.

predictions.pred_a_authority_population_self_patch_f: All authorities, 64 C rows, 179 sites, exact alignment, self-patch <=1e-4, finite outputs, and <=366 model forwards / 11712 row evaluations close.
predictions.pred_b_mlp1_is_generic_transport: MLP1 lies in the top decile of discovery control effect in both tasks and exceeds 0.20 target-scale effect on validation in at least one task.
predictions.pred_c_control_incidence_generalizes: Discovery-versus-validation site ranking by worst control fraction has Spearman >=0.70.
predictions.pred_d_selective_pool_contains_known_wri: The frozen selective top20 contains at least two of L9H1/L9H4/MLP7/MLP9 and at least one non-MLP site from layers 8--11.
predictions.pred_e_selective_pool_improves_validatio: Against the original tensor top20, the selective top20 lowers median validation worst-control fraction by >=50% while retaining >=50% of its median frozen target causal magnitude.

terminal_policy.generic_transport_confirmed_no_selective: B and C pass but D or E fails

decision: This is a discovery screen, not circuit promotion. Only its discovery-frozen pool may enter a later greedy composition test, whose sealed validation controls remain untouched by selection.
